$comment: The source of sf-editor-inline's interface (core/js/element-manifest.js over core/js/composition/manifest-host.mjs). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/inline-editor (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

input.summary: The text changed while it is edited; sent on the edited element

change.summary: The edit was committed (Enter, or the focus left): the content to save; sent on the edited element

cancel.summary: The edit was put back (Escape): the element shows its HTML from before; sent on the edited element

edit.summary: Starts editing an element of the canvas (SF.Composition.startInlineEdit): options content, nodeId, label, marks, links, messages, toolbar (session: the bar for the whole edit, over the element, the default; selection: only while text is selected, over the selection)

default.$comment: The carrier draws nothing: the edited element and the formatting toolbar are drawn by the composition module (core/js/composition/inline-editor.mjs) while an edit lasts.

accessibility.$comment: The carrier is hidden and has no role. While an edit lasts the edited element is role textbox (aria-multiline false) named from the edit's label with the language file's runtime.editing («{label}: редактирование. Enter — сохранить, Escape — отменить.»), and the toolbar is role toolbar with aria-pressed buttons.

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-editor-inline for the shim (stands/18-aliases-ci/alias.mjs, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (the shim sends the new and the old name), split / detail-adds (a detail adapter, refused by the shim), attribute-and-property, method, property, manifest-only (the DOM name does not change), host-attribute (no shim), retired. These events are sent on the edited element, which carries no shim: core/js/composition/inline-editor.mjs sends each former name itself, with its former detail.

rows.note: sent by the module after the new name; detail {node_id, content}
rows.summary: Dated alias of sf-inline-editor-input until 2026-12-01: Live normalized content after a change. Dispatched on the edited element; bubbles to document.

rows.note: sent by the module after the new name; detail {node_id, content}
rows.summary: Dated alias of sf-inline-editor-change until 2026-12-01: Editing finished with Enter or focus leaving; the host saves. Dispatched on the edited element; bubbles to document.

rows.note: sent by the module after the new name; detail {node_id}
rows.summary: Dated alias of sf-inline-editor-cancel until 2026-12-01: Editing was cancelled with Escape; the original HTML is restored. Dispatched on the edited element; bubbles to document.

rows.note: the element is sf-editor-inline; sf-inline-editor is a subclass defined beside it until the date

x-summary: Edits a content.heading or content.paragraph in place on the canvas -- strong, em, code, links and the inline component atoms -- and gives the host the normalised content model, never HTML.
x-renamed: events.sf-inline-edit-input {node_id, content} → input {id, content}: sf-inline-editor-input (x-native false: a CustomEvent input on a contenteditable element would be taken for the browser's own)
events.sf-inline-edit-commit {node_id, content} → change {id, content}: the committed value is a change (vocabulary 1.1.5 §5.1, as sf-theme-change → change); sf-inline-editor-change
lang runtime holds the words of the editor module (MESSAGES of core/js/composition/inline-editor.mjs)
x-decisions: events (vocabulary 1.1.5): input while the text changes, change when the edit is committed (a value changed -- the verb the vocabulary gives sf-theme-change; not save, a write with a revision and a client key the editor does not hold), cancel when it is put back (§5 cancel). Details hold data only in the vocabulary's words: {id, content}, id being the edit's nodeId. input and change are not the browser's events (x-native false): they are sf-inline-editor-input and sf-inline-editor-change, since the edited element is contenteditable and the browser sends its own input there.

the host contract stays: the events are sent on the edited element, bubble to the document, and each is followed by its former name with its former detail -- sf-inline-edit-input, -commit {node_id, content}, -cancel {node_id} -- until 2026-12-01. The element is the host's and carries no shim, so the module sends both itself; aliases.json records the rows for the journal and the sweep. INLINE_EVENTS holds the new names, INLINE_EVENTS_LEGACY the former.
own-verb-words: none -- commit became the vocabulary's change.

edit is the carrier's one action and the host's port (SF.Composition.startInlineEdit): it answers the session {element, commit(), cancel(), value()} as before, not an outcome -- the port stays as the composition editor uses it.

element: the carrier stays the plain element the composition module defines; defineInlineEditor(registry, {base}) extends the class core/js/composition/manifest-host.mjs makes from this component.json (the aliases.json shim, sfWord).
a11y-role: none for the hidden carrier; the edited element is role textbox while an edit lasts, the toolbar role toolbar.
a11y-name: the edited element's name is the edit's label with the language file's runtime.editing (accessibility.name from label).

key-effects: Enter commit, Escape revert, Mod+B, Mod+I, Mod+E toggle:strong, toggle:em, toggle:code, Mod+K open (the link form), Mod+Z step:-1 and Mod+Shift+Z or Mod+Y step:+1 (a step through the edit's history).
words (§11): the language files hold the editor module's words; the module keeps its copy and reads them through the page's language, since SF.Composition.startInlineEdit draws with them.
version 1.1.0: the events renamed behind dated aliases (§4.10).
examples: examples.json -- the carrier alone, and an edit started on a paragraph and on a heading (the carrier has no settings; an edit's options are the action's).

css-variables: five public variables of its sheet, all of an edit in progress: the edited element's outline, the toolbar's fill, radius, gap and padding. Not in src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json: its probe measures a component at rest, where none of these parts exist.

version 1.2.0: content.heading and content.paragraph 1.1.0 -- an inline component atom {type: component, name, props}, name one of badge, kbd, icon, button, is one caret stop: not editable inside, no marks, never inside a link; arrows step over it in one move, Backspace and Delete remove it whole, copy and paste keep it (the copied HTML carries the entry in data-sf-inline-node), its props drawn as attribute and text values only. Any other entry the editor does not know is kept the same way and comes back out unchanged.

version 1.1.2: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

version 1.3.0: the edit's option toolbar -- session (the default, as before: the bar for the whole edit, over the element) or selection (the bar only while text is selected or the link field is open, placed over the selected text). A flow editor where every paragraph is an edit took the bar out of the way from outside (simai/ui-source#67). SF.InlineEditor.INLINE_TOOLBAR_MODES names them; any other value throws inline_toolbar_unknown.

version 1.4.0: the tag is sf-editor-inline (naming decision 2026-11-02: sf-[set]-<block>[-<variant>]); the folder, the id smart.editor-inline and the bundle cl-editor-inline follow it. sf-inline-editor stays a dated alias until 2027-01-01: a subclass the Smart base defines beside the new tag, listed in the rule, in sheets as :is(sf-editor-inline, sf-inline-editor) (change journal tag-sf-inline-editor-to-sf-editor-inline, path-smart-inline-editor-to-editor-inline).

version 1.5.3: the size rule C18 (2026-11-09): the toolbar, its buttons and the link row read --sf-space-*, --sf-radius-1 with no raw rem fallbacks (the fallbacks disagreed with the tokens, which are always defined; nothing moves). Also: the error line (.sf-inline-editor-error) reads --sf-error with no raw fallback (owner decision C18, 2026-11-08: the raw fallback was a Material red, never reached under core.css). Also: the toolbar stands over the page: the overlay place (C20, the shadow system, owner 2026-11-08), --sf-shadow-overlay on --sf-surface-popup. Nothing else changes. Also: a patch, nothing drawn or done differently, and its reference unchanged: edit(element, options) stays positional, as the element's method takes it (core/js/composition/inline-editor.mjs), now said in x-registry.action-calls (positional) where the generator writes every other action in its object form. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged. Also: a patch, nothing drawn differently. edit takes the object form of its action too (standard §4.4): edit({element, options}) is edit(element, options), which stays. The runtime gives the class-written method that form (elementFromManifest's positional through manifestHost, core.runtime 1.43.0); the reference gives it one object argument (x-registry.action-calls is gone). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.
version 1.6.1 (2026-11-09): the toolbar declares a popup place (C16, the background system, owner 2026-11-08): what stands on it reads the theme's roles even inside a coloured block.

version 1.7.0 (2026-11-10, composition review F2.1): inline model 1.2.0. Shift+Enter inserts a soft line break {type: break}, with the marks and link of the character before it; the editor draws a break as
(data-sf-inline-break when it carries marks), reads
back as a break instead of a space, and copies it as a line end in plain text. The mark strike is known: kept, read from s, strike and del, drawn as s; the toolbar offers it only when the field's marks name it. Breaks in a row, at an edge, inside marks and inside a link are kept. Settings, values and events unchanged; Shift+Enter is a key of the edited text, not a key effect of the standard's closed list, so the keyboard map is unchanged.

version 1.6.3 (2026-11-10, composition review F1): a patch. A mark the inline model does not know (a newer producer's) survives an edit: it is drawn as a span carrying data-sf-inline-mark and read back from it, never as an element of that name, and the field's marks limit only the known ones. An atom is never inside a link: one pasted inside an <a> stands beside the link, which is split around it. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.6.2 (2026-11-10): a patch; nothing in the component changed. Its built sheet is a place (sf-place) and, with C43 (component.badges 1.5.0, tokens.colour 1.8.0), takes back the core role --sf-surface-underlay with one line, --sf-surface-underlay: initial, so a tonal badge inside it lays its tone over its own surface and not over a row further out. Nothing is drawn differently outside a selected row. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

start.description: SF.Composition.startInlineEdit(element, {content, nodeId, label, marks, links, messages}) or element.edit(target, options) returns {element, commit(), cancel(), value()}. Before the component is loaded startInlineEdit throws inline_editor_not_loaded. Also exposed as SF.InlineEditor {INLINE_EVENTS, readInlineDom, renderInlineDom, startInlineEdit, textOffset}.

links.description: http, https, mailto, tel, relative and fragment links only; protocol-relative and backslash addresses are refused, as in Document validation.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use the inline editor for text of content.heading and content.paragraph on an editor page. Save the committed content through the host Property contract, validate the Document and re-render.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not save HTML; events carry the content model
Do not offer lists; the content model has none
Do not call startInlineEdit before sf-editor-inline is defined

accessibility.focus: The sf-inline-editor carrier is hidden and has no role. While editing, the edited element becomes a labelled role=textbox with a visible outline; the formatting toolbar has aria-pressed states and aria-keyshortcuts. Enter commits, Escape cancels, focus leaving commits; IME composition is never interrupted.

sf-inline-edit-input.summary: Dated alias of sf-inline-editor-input until 2026-12-01: Live normalized content after a change. Dispatched on the edited element; bubbles to document. Its detail is the former one, {node_id, content}, not sf-inline-editor-input's {id, content}.

sf-inline-edit-commit.summary: Dated alias of sf-inline-editor-change until 2026-12-01: Editing finished with Enter or focus leaving; the host saves. Dispatched on the edited element; bubbles to document. Its detail is the former one, {node_id, content}, not sf-inline-editor-change's {id, content}.

sf-inline-edit-cancel.summary: Dated alias of sf-inline-editor-cancel until 2026-12-01: Editing was cancelled with Escape; the original HTML is restored. Dispatched on the edited element; bubbles to document. Its detail is the former one, {node_id}, not sf-inline-editor-cancel's {id}.
